(schema)  version=1
    markdown: "Coralogix Custom Dashboards folder. Folders organize dashboards into a navigable catalog. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/custom-dashboards/tutorials/manage-dashboard-catalog/."
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Unique identifier for the folder."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Display name of the folder. At least 1 and at most 100 characters; the API rejects a longer name."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
parent_id  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Parent folder id."
